limit_description: Lenna releases a wave of white-gold light. Each ally she can see within 30 ft. regains HP equal to 1d8 + her WIS modifier. One poisoned, frightened, or charmed condition may also be removed from one ally.
backstory:
Background: Temple Acolyte of the Crystal Chapel

Traits: Kind, trusting, deeply intuitive, terrible with maps and written instructions.
Goals: Heal the damage caused by the crystal disturbances and keep Cecil from sacrificing himself for everyone else.
Quirks: Gives every monster a chance to surrender. Talks to statues because “sometimes they answer.”
repeating_cantrips_-c1_cantrip_effect: Touch an ally to give +1d4 to an ability check.
repeating_cantrips_-c2_cantrip_effect: Target must succeed on a DEX save or take 1d8 radiant damage.
